info.title: cdp: run synthetic browser journeys
info.description: Run synthetic journeys (agent-browser commands, one per line) against Chrome over the DevTools Protocol, check them, export them to agent-browser, and snapshot pages. Native AOT.

commands.name: batch
commands.description:
Print a journey as agent-browser batch JSON: cdp batch x.journey |
agent-browser batch --bail

commands.name: run
commands.description:
Run journeys and print every checkpoint. A run reaches only the
base URL's host and allowed hosts.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help.

options.name: --base-url
options.description: What relative 'open' URLs resolve against: a URL, or a folder for file:// pages. [default: null]

options.name: --allow
options.description: [repeatable] Another host pattern the run may reach (repeatable): host, *.domain or *. [default: null]

options.name: --file-root
options.description: The folder file:// URLs may point into, when the base URL is not a folder. [default: null]

options.name: --artifacts
options.description: The folder journeys may write files into (screenshot, network har stop). Off unless given. [default: null]

options.name: --feature
options.description: [repeatable] A feature flag that is on (repeatable), for 'feature' blocks. [default: null]

options.name: --build-type
options.description: The build type, for build-type: conditions. [default: null]

options.name: --env
options.description: The environment's name, for env: conditions. [default: null]

options.name: --read-only
options.description: Refuse every request that is not GET, HEAD or OPTIONS, so the run cannot change a live site.

options.name: --writable
options.description: [repeatable] URL glob a read-only run may write to anyway (repeatable): ** anything, * anything but /. [default: null]

options.name: --header
options.description: [repeatable] A request header every page sends (repeatable): "Name: value". [default: null]

options.name: --user-agent
options.description: The user agent of the run. [default: null]

options.name: --viewport
options.description: The viewport the run starts with: 1280x800. Without it Chrome's default applies, which a responsive site may treat as a phone. [default: null]

options.name: --screenshot-on-failure
options.description: Take a screenshot of the page when a step fails. With --artifacts it is written to failure.png there.

options.name: --headed
options.description: Show the browser window.

options.name: --json
options.description: Print JSON; everything under a "page" key came from the page.

options.name: --max-output
options.description: Characters per checkpoint before it is cut (0 for no limit). [default: 20000]

options.name: --timeout
options.description: Seconds an action waits for its element (default 5). [default: default]

commands.name: screenshot
commands.description:
Open one page and save a PNG of it. Only the page's host is
reachable unless allowed.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help.

options.name: --output
options.description: The PNG file to write.

options.name: --selector
options.description: Only the first element this CSS selector matches. [default: null]

options.name: --full
options.description: The whole page, past the viewport.

options.name: --width
options.description: Viewport width in CSS pixels. [default: 1280]

options.name: --height
options.description: Viewport height in CSS pixels. [default: 720]

options.name: --allow
options.description: [repeatable] Another host pattern the page may reach (repeatable). [default: null]

options.name: --headed
options.description: Show the browser window.

arguments.name: URL
arguments.description: A URL, or a local HTML file.

commands.name: snapshot
commands.description:
Open one page and print its accessibility tree. Only the page's
host is reachable unless allowed.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help.

options.name: --compact
options.description: Drop empty structure and list markers.

options.name: --interactive
options.description: Only controls, headings and named landmarks.

options.name: --depth
options.description: Levels below the top to print. [default: default]

options.name: --selector
options.description: Only the tree of the first element this CSS selector matches. [default: null]

options.name: --allow
options.description: [repeatable] Another host pattern the page may reach (repeatable). [default: null]

options.name: --headed
options.description: Show the browser window.

options.name: --max-output
options.description: Characters before the tree is cut (0 for no limit). [default: 20000]

arguments.name: URL
arguments.description: A URL, or a local HTML file.
